findings.title: The panels sit flat against the page

location.description: The metric strip, the two chart panels, and the routes table panel, all white on the pale grey page.

findings.viewer_experience: The panels are separated from the page only by a faint hairline, so the dashboard reads as one flat surface and the eye has no layers to sort.

current.value: White panels with a one-pixel pale grey outline on a pale grey page.

findings.target: Each panel reads as a separate surface lifted from the page, without a heavier outline.
findings.fix_direction: Give the panels a clearer separation from the page.

closed_when.check: Look at the page: each panel is clearly a distinct surface against the background.
